entities.name: Raúl Fernández Robert

entities.summary: Raúl "El Foch" Fernández Robert was a Mexican basketball player. He competed in the 1936 Summer Olympics. Born in Mexico City, Fernández was part of the Mexican basketball team, which won the bronze medal. He played in all seven of the squad's matches.
